title: Dispatch, rebooted
dek: This site now runs a git-backed publishing pipeline. Here's the shape of it.
body:
LEAD: New paint, same philosophy. No backend, no database, nothing between you and the content but a static file.

This site is one HTML file plus a small publish layer. When I write a post, the editor commits it as JSON straight to the GitHub repo. Pages redeploys, and you see it. The whole pipeline sits in the repo where anyone can audit it. There is no server to trust.

## What's coming

Notes from the OpenVINO agent tooling I'm building, C++ things I learn the hard way, and the occasional tool worth sharing. Short, concrete, written when there's something to say.

> If a post is here, it earned the commit.
